line: Better pick a side and stay there, won’t play fair, we slangin’ sticks
vault_lines: Better pick a side and stay there, won't play fair, we slangin' sticks
meaning: Peezy is referencing gang conflict where people he knows either have to pick his side or get away from both sides.

line: I’ma get that big old house before I get that Patek
vault_lines: I'ma get that big old house before I get that Patek
meaning: This is a response to the culture in hip hop of flexing and overdoing things like jewelry and expensive cars. Lucci says that he wants to be responsible and invest in a house that he can live in for the rest of his life instead of spending on an expensive watch that will just make him look cool.

line: Could never hustle like my daddy ’cause my daddy was in prison (Damn)
vault_lines: Could never hustle like my daddy 'cause my daddy was in prison (Damn)
meaning: Yungeen Ace mentioned before in an interview with DJ Vlad about how his dad was locked up, but he also posted a picture with him while he was free.

line: Police, they labeled me as a menace, ’cused me for different bodies (Different bodies)
meaning: Yungeen Ace has been in and out of Jail a few times and JSO has accused him of many things he didn’t do. The worst example of this is after he was a sole survivor in a driveby shooting, the police brought him to jail and tried to blame the death of his two friends and his brother on him; even though he was shot 8 times in this incident.

line: Remember sleepin’ on the floor, wishin’ for a mattress (I wish)
vault_lines: Remember sleepin' on the floor, wishin' for a mattress (I wish)
meaning: Yungeen Ace was one of 12 brothers and struggled with poverty for many years which was probably the reason he didn’t have a mattress
